title: Grid_63
code:
//@version=5
strategy("Grid_63", overlay=true, initial_capital=100000, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1.0)

atr = ta.atr(14)
emaFast = ta.ema(close, 50)
emaSlow = ta.ema(close, 200)

basis = ta.sma(close, 28)
dev = 2.1 * ta.stdev(close, 28)
upper = basis + dev
lower = basis - dev
rsi = ta.rsi(close, 14)

utcHour = hour(time, "UTC")
inActiveSession = (utcHour >= 1 and utcHour <= 19) and (utcHour != 12)

dayNumber = dayofmonth(time, "UTC")
var int curDay = -1
var int dayTradeCount = 0
var int dayLossCount = 0
if dayNumber != curDay
    curDay := dayNumber
    dayTradeCount := 0
    dayLossCount := 0

var int prevClosed = 0
if strategy.closedtrades > prevClosed
    if strategy.closedtrades.profit(strategy.closedtrades - 1) <= 0
        dayLossCount += 1
    dayTradeCount += 1
    prevClosed := strategy.closedtrades

canTrade = dayLossCount < 1 and dayTradeCount < 2
passCrash = close >= (emaFast - 1.25 * atr)


wickLongOk = true
wickShortOk = true


longSig = inActiveSession and canTrade and passCrash and close > (emaSlow + 3) and low <= lower and close > open and rsi < 52 and wickLongOk and strategy.position_size == 0
shortSig = inActiveSession and canTrade and close < emaSlow and emaFast < emaSlow and high >= upper and close < open and rsi > 50 and wickShortOk and strategy.position_size == 0

var float ep = na
if longSig
    ep := close
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
    strategy.exit("Exit Long", from_entry="Long", stop=ep - 13.75, limit=ep + 14)

if shortSig
    ep := close
    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)
    strategy.exit("Exit Short", from_entry="Short", stop=ep + 13.75, limit=ep - 14)
